warnings: Hip roof (ปั้นหยา) on a steel frame: RC ring beams R1 on rows A and B and R2 on lines 1 and 4 (section R1-R2 on S-03); two trusses T1 at the hip apexes (x 1.50 and 6.00, labelled 'โครงถัก ดูแบบวิศวกรรม' / 'T1'); ridge อกไก่ between the apexes; four double hip rafters from the eave corners (1', 4''' / A''', B'') to the apexes; rafters (จันทันเหล็กกล่อง LG-100x50x2.3) on every dashed line of the 0.70 / 1.00 / 1.25 rafter chains.
The section designation is printed "LG -100x50x2.3 mm" with the word เหล็กกล่อง (box) — recorded designation LG as printed (section 6a: do not translate), d 100 / b 50 / t 2.3.
Hip spans are not printed; 3.82 m is the plan diagonal of the printed 1.20 + 1.50 offsets (2.70 on both axes) — span_source local_dimension, lower confidence.

Rafters and battens carry no mark: element_id null with element_name_assigned. Rafter lines are the dashed lines at every tick of the S-02 inner chains (x and, in the hip ends, y); their count is left null — the hip-end jack rafters are partly hidden under the hip linework on the scan.

Purlin conflict: this plan labels คร่าวเหล็กฉาก L-40x40x2.3 mm ทุกระยะ 0.80-0.90 ม. (เชื่อมติดกับตะเข้), while the S-04 truss detail prints แปเหล็ก [-75x45x15x2.3 mm @1.00 m. Both are recorded on their own sheets as printed; for the member spec the detail (S-04) wins per the conflict precedence, the L-40 คร่าว is kept here as the batten the plan names.
Columns C1 continue to the roof (small squares on R1 at every column point) — recorded once, in the footing-plan file.
